instruction: A faceted low-poly biplane with two stacked flat wings, angular struts, and a triangulated radial engine cowling. Flat-shaded panels in cherry red and cream meet crisply along hard edges, and a single blocky propeller sits centered on the nose.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Vintage Biplane in a low-poly flat-shaded style. A faceted low-poly biplane with two stacked flat wings, angular struts, and a triangulated radial engine cowling. Flat-shaded panels in cherry red and cream meet crisply along hard edges, and a single blocky propeller sits centered on the nose. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
